# Dana

> Dana is a self-hosted, open-source personal assistant for a household: a Python server (an agent loop over LiteLLM, SQLite, Docker) with Android apps for the phone, watch, wall tablet and TV, a web app and Telegram. Everything a user can turn on is an add-on: its own folder and git repository with an `addon.py` manifest and typed Python functions that Dana offers to the model as tools, plus hooks for the Now screen, the briefing, jobs, events and web pages.

The two guides below are written for coding agents: each says what to ask the person, one question at a time, and then the steps.

## Guides for agents

- [Install Dana](https://ronganam.github.io/dana/install.md): ask where it runs, how it is reached, which model provider, who uses it and which apps; then the Docker quick start, the setup link, HTTPS access, pairing the apps, Telegram, backups and checks
- [Build an add-on](https://ronganam.github.io/dana/build-an-addon.md): interview the person, propose the manifest, scaffold it with `bin/dana addons new`, the check / test / dev loop, install it on their Dana with `bin/dana addons install ./NAME --server URL --restart`, and publishing to the catalog

## Docs

- [Repository](https://github.com/ronganam/dana): the code, the README and the releases (server image `ghcr.io/ronganam/dana`, signed Android APKs)
- [Repository map](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/AGENTS.md): every part and its guide
- [Server guide](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/server/AGENTS.md): the server's docs index
- [Android guide](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/android/AGENTS.md): the apps' docs index
- [Add-on reference](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/server/docs/addon-reference.md): every manifest field, every hook with its signature and a tested example, the manifest's JSON schema (generated from the code)
- [Writing an add-on](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/server/docs/writing-an-addon.md): the guide (tools, jobs, events, pages, testing, workers)
- [The add-on design](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/docs/addons.md): where add-ons come from, needs and touches, the catalog, installing

## Optional

- [A new add-on's AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/server/cli/template/AGENTS.md.tmpl): the loop and the rules every scaffolded add-on carries
- [The showcase add-on](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/tree/master/examples/addons/showcase): one add-on using every capability once, with its tests
- [Configuration](https://github.com/ronganam/dana/blob/master/server/docs/configuration.md): every environment variable
- [The catalog](https://github.com/ronganam/dana-catalog): the add-ons anyone can install, and how to add one
